title: Nutritious Mexican Shrimp Tacos
description: A spicy and light Veracruzan dish featuring oregano and high protein friendly ingredients, served in scallop shells. This recipe is perfect for a brunch mood meal.
instructions: Rinse the shrimp under cold water and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a large bowl, whisk together lime juice, olive oil, garlic, cayenne pepper, salt, and oregano.
Add the shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Let the shrimp marinate for 10-15 minutes in the refrigerator.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Remove the shrimp from the marinade and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and cooked through.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by placing a cooked shrimp on each tortilla, then topping with scallions, cilantro, and any desired additional toppings.
Serve the tacos in scallop shells, if desired, and garnish with additional cilantro and lime wedges.
